decisions.decision: Build it all now. 1) Day titles: use the app/src/lib/curriculum.ts titles (Day 1 'Lock the Offer, the Buyer and the Channels Every Asset Is Built On', Day 2 'Build the Entire Funnel in One Pass', Day 3 'Hand the Funnel to an AI Agent, Then Prove Every Number') and the 'Most Complete Agentic RevOps System in B2B, Installed in Three Days' positioning in day-engine.tsx, sessions.ts, calendar.ts DAY_COPY and both landings. In eventSummary, wrap the title in titleCase(). 2) Change the Day 1 visual to show the eight decisions. 3) Use SESSION_TIME in workshop-client.tsx. 4) Delete every $50M+, including the host bio. Use the slim band instead (250+ brands, 10+ years, 21+ countries, 47+ industries). Keep a Cavli/Appster number only if it appears in usetantra.github.io/tantra-webinar-deck; otherwise cut it. 5) Fix the techstars and webinargeek SVG sizes, and drop the WebinarGeek mark from the masterclass FunnelOS. 6) Run Playwright with timezoneId Asia/Kolkata on a cold load of /workshop and record whether $99 flashes; fix it if it does. Then mark the ids fixed in AUDIT.md with the commit, push, and republish.
decisions.why: orchestrator-autonomy (2026-10-09) lets Claude decide the positioning question. curriculum.ts titles make all surfaces agree, which closes M011. enterprise-voice-rule and T-191 call 10 both say no $50M and use the slim band. The answer is the task's own recommendation.
